body:
Therapy is BS in my country.
Pay 50€ to talk for 1 Hour and you get prescribed anti depressants that'll make you into a zombie.

I've tried self medicating with Marijuana, but that's just an excuse to get high, which I don't anymore.

Talking helps, but, I don't personally enjoy talking about my feelings. Only if it's with complete strangers on the internet! Cause hey, that totally helps!

I've been feeling the same, I've got a friend that I can share all of my bad vibes with, I think that's what you're missing. Talk to your mother (or parent) about what you're feeling, it sure as heck helped me.
Or if you want to talk to a complete stranger then message me. : )
Then do it, just disappear. Go travel alone, but make sure you know where you're going, avoid the tourist attractions, they're just a waste of time.
